subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should this release remove the public `TelegramDmThreadReplies` Plugin SDK type now, or retain it as a deprecated type-only alias while runtime configuration rejects the retired key?
rationale: The repository policy treats shipped external Plugin SDK removals as compatibility-sensitive, and implementation evidence alone cannot choose the intended public deprecation window.

options.title: Retain a deprecated type alias
options.body: Keep the exported alias until the documented external SDK deprecation window ends while retaining the runtime config retirement.

options.title: Approve immediate SDK removal
options.body: Explicitly accept a breaking external TypeScript upgrade for this release and document the required downstream migration.

recommendation.title: Retain a deprecated type alias
recommendation.body: Keep the exported alias until the documented external SDK deprecation window ends while retaining the runtime config retirement.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows this contributor owns the proposed config-surface and SDK-contract changes.
